requirements.title: Scenario-based Gameplay
requirements.description: Provide business executives with interactive, AI-focused scenarios for learning and decision-making practice.
acceptance_criteria: Executives can successfully complete a set of predefined scenarios

requirements.title: Adjustable Difficulty Levels
requirements.description: Allow users to customize the difficulty level based on their existing AI knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: Users can select and complete scenarios at different levels of difficulty

requirements.title: Real-world Business Scenarios
requirements.description: Simulate real-life AI project situations for practical learning.
acceptance_criteria: Scenarios are based on actual business cases

requirements.title: Immediate Feedback Mechanism
requirements.description: Offer users feedback to help them improve their understanding of AI concepts.
acceptance_criteria: Users receive constructive feedback after each scenario

requirements.title: Subscription-based Platform
requirements.description: Provide access to the game as a subscription service.
acceptance_criteria: Users can subscribe and gain access to the platform

requirements.title: Evolution of Scenarios
requirements.description: Regularly update scenarios to keep content fresh and relevant.
acceptance_criteria: New scenarios are added on a regular basis
